name: identity-toolkit
description: Browser-only identity, claims and federation diagnostics for JWT/JOSE, OIDC/OAuth, SAML, WS-Federation and OpenID Federation.

scripts.test:core: node --test tests/unit/detector.test.js tests/unit/jwt.test.js tests/unit/claims.test.js tests/unit/federation.test.js tests/unit/oidc.test.js tests/unit/oauth.test.js tests/unit/openid-federation.test.js tests/unit/xml-utils.test.js
scripts.check:syntax: find public/assets/js scripts tests/unit tests/browser \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
scripts.check:core: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:static && npm run test:core
scripts.check: npm run vendor:xmldsig && npm run verify:vendor && npm run check:syntax && npm run check:static && npm test
